svg.title: EKS Observable Platform — implementation architecture
svg.desc: Architecture derived from commit f70bce8. Terraform provisions AWS infrastructure. Two public ALBs target pod IPs for podinfo and production. Dev is internal. All workloads and monitoring share one managed node group in one public subnet. Prometheus scrapes metrics and evaluates alerts; Grafana queries Prometheus and Loki; Promtail pushes logs to Loki. GitHub Actions builds tagged images and deploys through OIDC roles.
svg.text: Implementation architecture • AWS ap-south-2 • Source snapshot f70bce8 • Learning lab
VPC · EKS · node group · ECR · IAM / OIDC
S3 state + native locking; bucket pre-created
Two AZs for subnet coverage; no NAT Gateway
Runtime access & EKS workloads — logical view
Shared managed node group: m7i-flex.large · desired/min 1, max 2 · workers only in subnet 10.0.0.0/24 (one AZ)
ALBs are AWS resources outside Kubernetes. Namespace boxes do not imply separate networks or dedicated workers.
Ingress + Service selectors discover pod endpoints;
ALBs send requests directly to those pod IPs.
k6-testing: podinfo load Pod → podinfo ClusterIP :9898
Application k6 Jobs use their own namespace’s ClusterIP service and bypass the public ALB.
Only logs emitted by the containers are collected; request logging is not enabled in the Flask image.
PrometheusRules: errors · latency · restarts · fault mode
Metrics Server supports kubectl top. No HPA or cluster autoscaler is declared. Monitoring shares the workloads’ failure domain.
Tagged commit must be on main
OIDC CI role → build + push ECR
Choose an existing ECR image tag
Prod OIDC role → Helm + k6 gates
Rollout fails → Helm --atomic recovery. Smoke or load fails → restore the recorded revision; uninstall if no prior release exists.
Prometheus / Alertmanager observe continuously. Their alerts do not initiate rollback.
* Required reviewers are an external GitHub setting. The workflow checks ECR tag existence; it does not enforce successful dev validation.
Scope: public-subnet, single-AZ worker lab · metrics and logs only · no application database, tracing stack, or durable telemetry storage configured.
